pilot_rounds.note: First draft (5 multi, 5 tool). Silent NOTED tracking, a bare-number echoed counter and every tool task needing arithmetic between read and write failed. Only the kv pointer-chain task passed.

Reworked to 6 multi / 4 tool: added a latest-value overwrite task, labelled echo (STOCK:/TOTAL:), free acknowledgement, simpler object moves, explicit calc hints. Passes: dev-01, dev-02, dev-04, dev-09. dev-05 failed partly on format (model wrapped the JSON array in an object) as well as on a tracking error.

Final file. dev-05 answer format changed to a labelled comma-separated line with an anchored regex; dev-07 replaced by a kv consolidation task; dev-08 given a stepwise hint. Same four passes. dev-05 still fails on a real tracking error (duplicated name); dev-07 computed the right sum but skipped the required kv_set; dev-08 added a 'sold' amount and updated only one of two keys.

what_i_did: Read lab/TASKS.md, lab/core.py (episode loop, checkers), lab/validate_tasks.py and lab/pilot.py.
Wrote 10 dev tasks with a generator script that asserts every expected state by simulation.
Ran 3 pilot rounds on the baseline (the limit) and read every reply.

After round 3, changed only two difficulty labels to match observed results (dev-07 easy -> medium, dev-09 medium -> easy); prompts, env and checks are identical to the piloted round-3 file, and the file was revalidated.
Wrote the family spec with reply policies, answer formats, checker patterns, observed pitfalls, an example task, difficulty guidance and five sub-themes.
known_limitations: Final pass rate 0.40 sits at the low edge of the target band; spec.md tells generators to skew slightly easier than the dev set.
All four passes are easy or medium tasks; all three hard tasks fail, and 3 of the 4 tool tasks fail, so the tool half of the family is close to floor on the baseline.
dev-03 fails by an off-by-one arithmetic slip after a correction rather than by losing the update outright.
The two relabelled difficulties were set after seeing the results, so difficulty labels in the dev set are fitted to the baseline.
